note: Where the Ono plugins write files into a work repo. Ono rule (2026-11-10): only code goes into a commit by default — the files on the 'commit' lists below stay OUT unless the employee asks for one or the project lists it in .platform-guardian.json commitPaths. The session closer never .gitignores these. Patterns are git-style globs relative to the repo root. 'neverCommit' lists plugin scratch files that land in the repo but must not be committed. Generated ledger/readiness files must never be edited, formatted or line-ending-normalized.
